turns.prompt_text: how can you send messages over a group text without losing quality
turns.response_html:
You can avoid quality loss in group messages by:

  1. Using a modern messaging app like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal that either supports high-quality settings or allows sending media as uncompressed files/documents.
  2. Sharing a link from a cloud service like Google Photos, Google Drive, Dropbox, or OneDrive.
  3. Using RCS messaging (Rich Communication Services) on Android, which supports higher quality media than traditional MMS.
  4. Disabling "Low-Quality Image Mode" in iMessage settings on iPhone.

turns.prompt_text: how can RCS be enabled on a Google pixel
turns.response_html: Open the Google Messages app, tap your Profile picture or Initial in the top right, go to Messages settings > RCS chats (or Chat features), and Turn on RCS chats.
